description: This Java class defines a command for purging namespace data within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes static factory methods for creating instances, JSON deserialization logic, and inherits from an abstract namespace command.

classes.name: PurgeNamespace
classes.description: A final class representing a command to purge a specific namespace, including static factory methods, JSON deserialization, and overridden methods for setting headers and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of PurgeNamespace with a specified namespace and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PurgeNamespace instance from a JSON object and headers, deserializing the JSON structure.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new PurgeNamespace instance with the specified DittoHeaders if they differ from the current instance.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of PurgeNamespace to support equality checks.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the PurgeNamespace instance.
